provenance.statement: Derived label-free: these are the Otsu cuts this exact configuration computes (threshold.PREFERRED over each behaviour's own positive recorded scores), frozen so future score-changing cycles cannot move them. Escalation source: m0422 admitted by threshold drift in 3/3 closed cycles (standing escalation in dossiers/baseline-2026-08-03__containment-v1.1-kindinherit/decision.json); cut_stability.py (cut_stability_results.json) measured the near-cut bystander class as structural, not a one-off. No panel value was consulted in choosing these values: they freeze exactly what the label-free rule itself computed on this config.
